scope: Equation-system versus Krylov-backend separation; four binary solve combinations, no new physical binary acceptance
default_preservation: Archived Hi GMRES and BY BiCGStab default full states, counts and BY traces remain bit-identical; default forcing/row weights/line preconditioner stay unchanged

matrix_case.configuration: moderate generic unequal .6/.4 masses, centers +/-3, same published JSON inputs from prior common_stopping experiment
matrix_case.preconditioners: fixed current modal preconditioner for each system, identical between that system's two Krylov methods

within_system_data_acceptance.all_retained_arrays: finite; raw native near-puncture derivative arrays remain diagnostics outside core equivalence bounds

independent_linear_controls: known nonsymmetric full dense matrices, identity/exact diagonal M, zero/nonzero guesses, zero RHS, happy breakdown, restart/exhaustion, singular/breakdown, callback failures and malformed options; true residual always independently recomputed
limits: No comparison equates different BY/HiSpID physical data or accuracy. Default and cross-backend failures remain retained; no silent fallback. One numerical worker at a time.
